senses.gloss: to look in, read. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 34 אסור … לעַיֵּין בתורה וכ׳ the interpreter must not look into the Torah (Hebrew text) and translate; (Pesik. R. s. 5 ליתן עיניו).
to look carefully; to search, investigate (cmp. דּוּק a. דִּקְדֵּק).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 115a:9">B. Bath. 115ᵃ</cite> (ref. <he>ובן אין לו</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 27:8">Num. XXVII, 8</cite>) <he>עַיֵּין עליו</he> (Ar. <cite ref="A01238"><he>אַיֵּין</he></cite>) investigate his case (whether he has really no male issue); <cite ref="Yevamot 22b">Yeb. 22ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 4a:6">Kidd. 4ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 22:13">Lev. XXII, 13</cite> <he>וזרע אין לה</he>) <he>עיין לה</he>; <cite ref="Yevamot 70a:7">Yeb. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>עיין עלה</he> (Chald.).

<cite ref="Berakhot 55a:1">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>המאריך בתפלתו ומְעַיֵּין בה</he> he who stays long in prayer and speculates on it (expecting its fulfillment as a reward for his lengthy prayer); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 950:13">Yalk. Prov. 950</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 32b">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

units: B. Bath. 89ᵃ אין מְעַיְּינִין … במקום שמעיינין where it is customary to give overweight, you dare not sell by exact weight, and vice versa; a. e.—Part. pass. מְעוּיָּין
